Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(
    varMVF_Selected,
    Filter(
        varMVF_Selected,
        Code <> ThisItem.Code
    )
)

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        cmp_MultiValueFilter.Items,
        IsBlank(txtMVF_Search.Text) ||
        StartsWith(Display, txtMVF_Search.Text) ||
        StartsWith(Code, txtMVF_Search.Text)
    ),
    "SortOrder",
    SortOrder.Ascending,
    "Display",
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

If(
    CountRows(varMVF_Selected) = 0 && CountRows(varMVF_Invalid) = 0,
    "",
    CountRows(varMVF_Selected) & " selected" &
    If(
        CountRows(varMVF_Invalid) > 0,
        " · " & CountRows(varMVF_Invalid) & " not found",
        ""
    )
)
